name: Endor AURI for Developers
description: Answers open-source vulnerability, package-risk, and CVE questions from Endor's public data. No login, no customer data. DEPLOYMENT: this agent runs in your own Google Cloud project, provisioned via the 'Endor AURI for Developers' Google Cloud Marketplace listing (Terraform/VM), which stands up the Cloud Run service and sets this card's live 'url' automatically. If you are viewing this as a static template (its 'url' still points to the agents.endorlabs.com placeholder), the agent will NOT respond until you deploy it via the Marketplace listing — do not register the template card directly. See documentationUrl for setup.

extensions.description: Provides agent driven UI using the A2UI JSON format.

skills.name: Open Source Intelligence
skills.description: Look up a CVE/GHSA, list known vulnerabilities for a package version, or get Endor risk scores for an open-source package.
examples: What's the risk score for npm://lodash@4.17.20?
